title.es: Una nota sobre la excursión escolar
title.en: A Note About the School Trip

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre school trip.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about school trip.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Hi Ana, the school trip is on Friday. Please meet us at the main gate at seven thirty. Bring a raincoat, a bottle of water, and your student card. The bus leaves at eight. We will visit the science museum and eat lunch in the park. Please tell Mr Lee if you need a vegetarian meal.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Hi Ana, the school trip is on Friday. Please meet us at the main gate at seven thirty. Bring a raincoat, a bottle of water, and your student card. The bus leaves at eight. We will visit the science museum and eat lunch in the park. Please tell Mr Lee if you need a vegetarian meal.

objectives.es: Explicar una respuesta con evidencia textual.
